headline: Turn inbound purchase orders into validated draft sales orders
capabilities: Reads each PO into structured fields and shows the queue
Validates the PO against the accepted quote with a per-line price tolerance
Checks the configuration and classifies the order
Prepares a draft sales order with every exception for the specialist
outcomes: Stops errors before they reach the ERP
Enters ready orders first and routes exceptions with a reason
why_try: The demo works a five-order queue in seven plain questions, from reading a PO to a ready-to-enter draft, and nothing is ever submitted to the ERP.

sample_prompts.label: Sales Operations Specialist: Pending PO queue
sample_prompts.prompt: What's in my PO queue this morning?

sample_prompts.label: Sales Operations Specialist: Purchase order extraction
sample_prompts.prompt: Read PO-4471 and pull out the order details.

sample_prompts.label: Product Configuration Analyst: Configuration check
sample_prompts.prompt: Check the product configuration on the Coho Refining order.

sample_prompts.label: Sales Operations Specialist: Order classification
sample_prompts.prompt: What order type, class and sales channel should PO-4471 go in as?

sample_prompts.label: Sales Operations Specialist: Draft sales order
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare the sales order for PO-4471 so I can enter it.

sample_prompts.label: Sales Operations Manager: Queue readiness review
sample_prompts.prompt: Across the whole queue, which orders are ready to enter and which need a fix?

business_flow: Accepted quote and configuration rule book
Specialist enters the order in the ERP
